qualifier: ERK5, p38 and atypical MAPK branches to CREB
name: TRKA-driven ERK5, p38 and atypical MAPK cascades
rationale: Members are MAPK branches (ERK5, p38, MAPK4/6, FRS2/ARMS adaptors) leading to CREB and transcription after TRKA activation; confusables instead carry NTRK3, PLC-gamma, PI3K and STAT3 arms.

qualifier: extracellular ligand sequestration
name: BMP/TGF-beta SMAD signalling regulation and extracellular ligand sequestration
rationale: All members regulate BMP, TGF-beta or NODAL SMAD signalling, several by trapping ligand in the extracellular matrix; confusables concern somitogenesis/left-right patterning, endothelial fate or nuclear SMAD transcription.

qualifier: nodal and His-Purkinje development and depolarization
name: Cardiac conduction system development and pacemaker depolarization
rationale: Members cover SA/AV node and His-Purkinje development, HCN and phase-0 depolarization and gap-junction coupling, whereas confusables centre on repolarization phases and potassium channels.

qualifier: SRF-driven contractile cytoskeleton and smooth muscle differentiation
name: Vascular wall cell identity and SRF contractile programme
rationale: Members combine SRF actin/contractile targets with vascular smooth muscle development, matrix adhesion and endothelial/perivascular modules; confusables add shear-stress responses and smooth muscle phenotypic switching.

qualifier: heme scavenging from plasma
name: Heme scavenging and cellular iron uptake
rationale: Members concern heme scavenging/transport and cellular iron import and homeostasis, distinct from confusables built on transferrin cycling, cadmium or oxygen/selenium responses.

qualifier: adrenal and gonadal steroidogenesis, secretion and response
name: Steroid and thyroid hormone biosynthesis, secretion and signalling
rationale: Members cover CYP-dependent corticosteroid, sex-steroid and thyroid hormone synthesis, secretion and response; confusables are growth hormone/prolactin/leptin signalling or vitamin metabolism.

qualifier: with IL-10
name: IL-12 family and IL-10 cytokine signalling
rationale: Members are signalling by the IL-12 family (IL-12, IL-23, IL-27, IL-35) and IL-10; confusables add IL-15/IL-21, IL-20/type III interferon, or cytokine production rather than signalling.

qualifier: with promotion of phospholipid and triglyceride synthesis
name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and glycerolipid synthesis regulation
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation/fusion and regulation of phosphatidylcholine and triglyceride synthesis in adipocytes, while confusables emphasise droplet disassembly, lipophagy and triglyceride turnover.

qualifier: craniofacial, limb, ear and pharyngeal endocrine glands
name: Embryonic craniofacial, limb, ear and endocrine gland morphogenesis
rationale: Members are morphogenesis of face, palate, ear, limbs and pharyngeal/endocrine glands (thymus, thyroid, parathyroid, pituitary); confusables shift to neural plate patterning, outflow tract or cochlea/salivary development.

qualifier: via AKT-FOXO, p53 and mTORC1
name: AKT-FOXO, p53 and mTORC1 control of glycolytic metabolism
rationale: Members link AKT-regulated FOXO, p53 metabolic targets and mTORC1 to regulation of glycolysis, pentose phosphate shunt and nucleotide catabolism; confusables are fermentation/fructose bisphosphate or NFE2L2 programmes.

qualifier: pseudouridylation and methylation across rRNA, tRNA, mRNA
name: Pseudouridylation and methylation of rRNA, tRNA and mRNA
rationale: All members are pseudouridine or methyl modifications of cytoplasmic/nuclear RNAs; confusables involve snoRNP assembly, mitochondrial RNA modification or tRNA aminoacylation and processing.

core: Regulation of insulin sensitivity and glucose uptake
qualifier: adiponectin signalling
name: Regulation of insulin sensitivity, glucose uptake and adiponectin
rationale: Members regulate insulin receptor responsiveness, glucose import and glycogen synthesis together with adiponectin secretion and signalling; confusables focus on GLUT4 translocation, IRS/AKT2 activation or glucagon.

qualifier: with mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown, ESCRT sealing and abscission
name: SUMOylation and mitotic nuclear envelope turnover
rationale: Members are SUMO conjugation of many substrate classes plus lamina depolymerization, nuclear envelope reformation/ESCRT-III sealing and abscission; confusables are chromosome condensation, spindle events or nuclear pore transport.

core: Neuropeptide and neuroendocrine control of behaviour
qualifier: HPA axis, feeding, sleep and mating
name: Neuropeptide and HPA-axis control of feeding, sleep and behaviour
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/opioid GPCR signalling, glucocorticoid stress axis and appetite hormones with feeding, sleep, mating and stress behaviours; confusables are GH/prolactin JAK-STAT, dopamine signalling or beta-cell development.

qualifier: with regulation of mitochondrial respiration and ferroptosis
name: Mitochondrial respiration control and peroxide-induced cell death
rationale: Members regulate oxidative phosphorylation/electron transport and ROS production alongside hydrogen peroxide-, hypoxia- and iron-driven (ferroptotic) death; confusables involve nitrosative stress, ischemia or hydrogen sulfide.

qualifier: with suppression of terminal myeloid differentiation
name: Myeloid progenitor expansion and restrained myeloid differentiation
rationale: Members cover common myeloid progenitor proliferation, the promyelocyte granule programme and negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation; confusables drive differentiation, HSC maintenance or megakaryopoiesis.

qualifier: MITF-M transcriptional programme
name: MITF-M melanocyte transcriptional programme and melanin synthesis
rationale: Members are MITF-M target gene programmes, melanin synthesis, pigment granule localization and melanocyte proliferation/UV response; confusables are melanosome assembly or keratinocyte differentiation.

qualifier: with eicosanoid and leukotriene inactivation
name: Pro-resolving lipid mediator synthesis and eicosanoid catabolism
rationale: Members synthesise lipoxins, resolvins, protectins and maresins and inactivate leukotrienes by omega-oxidation; confusables concern leukotriene synthesis/receptors, 12-HETE/hepoxilins or PAF.

core: Amino acid and organic acid metabolism
qualifier: general, not specific to any amino acid
name: General amino acid and organic acid metabolism
rationale: All members are broad umbrella terms for amino acid and organic acid synthesis and breakdown, whereas confusables name specific amino acids (threonine, tyrosine/phenylalanine, proline/glycine).

qualifier: methyl-DNA binding and T308 phosphorylation defects
name: MECP2 loss-of-function defects in Rett syndrome
rationale: All three members are Rett-associated MECP2 defects (loss of 5mC/5hmC binding and T308 phosphorylation); confusables concern MECP2 targets, CREB/NPAS4 activity signalling or DNA/histone methylation.

qualifier: arterial and coronary, with endothelial differentiation control
name: Arterial and coronary vessel formation and endothelial differentiation
rationale: Members cover coronary vasculogenesis, dorsal aorta and arterial endothelial differentiation, vessel maturation and cardiac smooth muscle differentiation; confusables emphasise venous/CNS/lymphatic vessels or BMP-driven heart morphogenesis.

core: Regulation of intracellular calcium store release
qualifier: ER/SR release and resequestration
name: Regulation of ER/SR calcium store release and sequestration
rationale: Members regulate release of sequestered calcium (including ryanodine receptors) and ER calcium content; confusables cover store-operated entry or cardiac contraction and calcium extrusion.

qualifier: ornithine-citrulline-arginine biosynthesis and its regulation
name: Urea cycle operation and ornithine-citrulline-arginine biosynthesis
rationale: Members are the urea cycle, its transcriptional repression and citrulline/arginine/ornithine synthesis; confusables are urea cycle enzyme deficiencies or arginine catabolism and transport.

qualifier: Hedgehog autoprocessing and Ras C-terminal modification
name: Hedgehog and Ras lipid modification and processing
rationale: Members are Hedgehog autoproteolysis, N-terminal palmitoylation and release, and Ras C-terminal processing; confusables centre on cysteine palmitoylation/depalmitoylation and WNT/PORCN lipidation.

qualifier: alpha-2 and Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition
name: Adrenergic cAMP-PKA signalling with alpha-2 adenylate cyclase inhibition
rationale: Members cover adrenoceptor signalling, cAMP synthesis/degradation and PKA activation with alpha-2/Gz inhibition of adenylate cyclase and catecholamine secretion; confusables are calcium/PLC signalling, adenosine or dopamine-driven cyclase activation.
